message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
My goal is to find a common 30-minute meeting slot for all four partners next week.
Alison has already provided the available slots for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale.
I need to check the calendars for Elena Soto and David Okafor to see which of those slots they are also free.
My plan is:
1. Read Elena Soto's calendar.
2. Read David Okafor's calendar.
3. Compare the available slots from Alison with the free times of Elena and David.
4. Identify a common slot that works for everyone.
5. Communicate this common slot to Alison in the workspace so she can book it.
I'll start by reading the two calendars I have access to. This will take two actions. Then I'll have all the information needed to find a solution. I will then use a third action to communicate my findings to Alison. This seems like an efficient use of my first work session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
